claims.content: To register a new staff member under an existing Voucher Service Provider (VSP) in the system.

goal.raw_text: To register a new staff member under an existing Voucher Service Provider (VSP) in the system.

claims.content: The user must be logged into the system with appropriate privileges to create new staff records.
A Voucher Service Provider (VSP) master record must already exist in the system under which the new staff member will be registered.
If the specific 'Staff Type' for the new employee does not exist in the system's master list, it must be created prior to or during this process.
The MSIU Field Office User initiates the process to capture details of a new VSP staff member for entering claims into the system.

trigger.raw_text: The MSIU Field Office User initiates the process to capture details of a new VSP staff member for entering claims into the system.

claims.content: The MSIU Field Office User navigates to the 'VSP Staff Master Information' module within the system.
The user initiates the creation of a new staff record.
The system prompts the user to enter the mandatory details for the new staff member: VSP Name, Staff Code, Staff Name, Staff Type, and Qualification.
For the 'Staff Type' field, the user selects from a pre-defined list of staff types populated from the Staff Type Master.

If the required 'Staff Type' is not available in the list, the system provides an option for the user to navigate to the Staff Type Master screen, create the new type, and then return to complete the staff registration.
Upon saving the new entry, the system automatically generates a unique 'Staff Code' using the format: [VSP Code] + 'SC' + [3-digit sequence number] (e.g., HP0001SC001).
If the user attempts to create a staff record with a name that already exists for that VSP, the system displays a warning message but allows the user to proceed and save the record if necessary.
The system saves the new staff member's information, making them available for association with claims submitted by the VSP.
A new staff member record is created and stored in the system under the specified Voucher Service Provider (VSP).
The newly registered staff member has a unique, automatically generated Staff Code following the format: [VSP Code] + 'SC' + [3-digit sequence number].
The new staff member's details (Name, Type, Qualification) are available for selection when entering claim information into the system.
If a new Staff Type was required and did not previously exist, it has been successfully added to the Staff Type Master list.
